title: New Inventory Part lists its fields in the set order
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Scroll the window from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Cost, Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (the bin row, then "Add Bin Location"). There is no Part Status, and the cost field reads "Cost", not "Average Cost".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”
